description: Approved Dashboard Collection-based dataset presentation references. Generated Dashboard Collection controls must select one of these references and preserve the selected template structure; unknown or simplified Collection layouts are not generated-final eligible.

collection_control_grid_table.message: The legacy Flex Grid Collection template is retired. Migrate to the native responsive Table/Card Collection.

collection_control_grid_table_with_multi.message: The legacy Flex Grid multiselect template is retired. Migrate to the native responsive Table/Card multiselect Collection.

references.sourceReference: Company Overview v1.4 / Collection_control_responsive_card_grid export-shaped component template
whenToUse: Users need to browse business records as responsive cards.
The dataset has a small to medium field set with visual status, owner, date, file, image, or summary metadata.
Card scanning is more useful than dense row comparison.
The page needs a display-first card grid, optionally with item operations for Data List or Document Library sources.
whenNotToUse: Bulk row/card selection or a selected-items toolbar is required.
The requirement asks for table headers, column alignment, or grid-table scanning.
The source is Form Report or Data Report and edit/delete item operations are requested; those sources are view-only.
references.requiredAppPlanDeclaration: Select collection_control_responsive_card_grid for the Dashboard dataset region and explain the card-browsing/display-first business reason, plus whether item operations are allowed by the source type.
generationProof: collection_control_responsive_card_wrapper component root
card_col_body Collection root with explicit template provenance
card_col_item repeated item template with Dynamic controls matched to field types
no Dynamic image unless the selected data source has an Image field
grid_table_col_item_op_menu actions and delete-confirmation temp variable only when item operations are present
references.proofBoundary: Export-proven responsive card grid component only; not proof for grid-table, card multiselect toolbar, grouped, nested, gallery, timeline, or Kanban layouts. Form Report/Data Report uses are view-only and must not include edit/delete item actions.

references.sourceReference: Projects Center_1 / Collection_control_grid_table (new) / Responsive Collection export-shaped template
whenToUse: Users need dense table scanning on computer, laptop, and tablet while retaining readable cards on mobile.
The dataset has operational columns such as title, owner, dates, progress, status, or priority and benefits from native table-column sorting.
One responsive Collection must serve both desktop/tablet operations and mobile record browsing without separate page implementations.
whenNotToUse: Multi-record selection and batch actions are required; use collection_control_responsive_multiple_select or collection_control_card_with_multiselect_toolbar.
The experience is primarily a visual card gallery, Kanban board, timeline, grouped list, or nested collection.
references.requiredAppPlanDeclaration: Select collection_control_responsive for the Dashboard dataset region and state why desktop/tablet table scanning plus mobile card presentation is required, whether native column sorting is needed, and whether item operations are allowed by the source type.
generationProof: full grid_table_col_wrapper subtree cloned from docs/reference/collection-control-responsive.template.json
Collection root preserves native tablecols, header, body, table, pagination, and list-display-preference contracts
each native table column has a mapped title, item-template control, and sortable source field when sorting is enabled
grid_table_col_item_operations preserves attrs.common.zidx = [null, 2] so row-operation clicks stay above whole-row click handling
same Collection renders as the configured table presentation on computer/laptop/tablet and card presentation on mobile
optional item operations bind to matching Collection actions and delete retains confirmation plus bounded target-list removal
references.proofBoundary: Export-proven and configuration-visible responsive Collection component. Generated-package responsive behavior must still be verified on desktop/tablet/mobile before claiming runtime proof.

exportShapeContract.lockedRule: Preserve the export-shaped native table/card responsive Collection mechanism; do not replace it with the legacy Flex Grid table or a static card lookalike.

references.sourceReference: Projects Center_1 / All Tasks - multiple select (new) / grid_table_col_multiselect_wrapper export-shaped template
whenToUse: Users need native table scanning on computer, laptop, and tablet plus Card view on mobile.
The business process requires multi-row selection, selected count, and batch operations.
The page must preserve the complete page-level selection variables, batch Form Actions, confirmation flows, and Collection actions from the source pattern.
whenNotToUse: The source is read-only Form Report or Data Report; use collection_control_responsive for display-only responsive presentation.
The experience is primarily a visual card gallery, Kanban board, timeline, grouped list, or nested Collection.
references.requiredAppPlanDeclaration: Select collection_control_responsive_multiple_select for the Dashboard dataset region and name the required batch operation, selected-count behavior, and the need for native desktop/tablet Table view with mobile Card view.

leading selection control with checked/unchecked states and Collection Select Items action

page-level Change multiple items to completed, Delete multiple items, Set default values, and onLoad formAction dependencies preserved and scoped
batch toolbar action buttons remain bound to page actions
Collection actions preserve Select Items, Edit item, Delete item, and Mark current item as Completed contracts
references.proofBoundary: Export-proven and configuration-visible responsive/multiselect behavior only. Generated-package desktop/tablet/mobile rendering and batch execution require focused runtime verification before claiming runtime proof.
exportShapeContract: preserve grid_table_col_item_select and native Table/Card structures
preserve Collection root attrs.actions and all page-level filterVars, tempVars, filter, actions, and formAction dependencies
allow edits only in grid_table_col_title_wrapper, op_normal, op_multipleselected, native tablecols/item controls, and grid_table_col_item_operations
do not substitute a legacy Flex Grid header/item pair or omit page-level action dependencies
editableRegions: native tablecols labels, sortable fields, and repeated item controls
lockedRegions: page-level filterVars, tempVars, actions, filter, and formAction dependency graph

references.sourceReference: Marketing Event Management Event Portfolio Dashboard Golden Reference
whenToUse: The Dashboard needs a high-fidelity primary operations list.
Rows need rich status badge, progress, owner/person, health, budget/date, or similar visual cells.
The region is the main dashboard work queue, pipeline, or portfolio table.
whenNotToUse: A lightweight secondary list is enough.
The business asks for cards or bulk checkbox selection.
The region does not need the richer Event Portfolio visual treatment.
